Ganesha Ka Haathi Wala Sar — Asli Kahani! 🐘

🔱 Ganesha elephant head origin Parvati Shiva beheading

Parvati created Ganesha from sandalwood paste and breathed life into him, appointing him as guard while she bathed. Shiva returned and didn't recognize his own son — Ganesha stopped him. An enraged Shiva beheaded him. A heartbroken Parvati demanded Shiva restore him. Shiva sent servants North and they brought back an elephant's head — the first living creature they found sleeping with its head pointing North.
